question: Can the distributed L9H1/H4 aspectual read be compressed to the period and determiner source terms downstream of since/by?
population: The same 64 valid A1/A2 discovery rows. This is a post-localization mechanistic compression test, not an independent generalization test.
operator: Simultaneously replace the named paired donor attention source terms inside the otherwise native base L9H1/H4 preprojection activations at the final subject query, then run the exact suffix.

source_positions.determiner: cue+3, verified as the token `the` on all 64 rows

predictions.pred_a_exact_source_closure: The all-changed-sources arm matches the complete H1/H4 pair scored logits within 1e-4 on every row.
predictions.pred_b_period_determiner_compression: The period+determiner bank retains at least 60% of complete-pair mean recovery and has direction fraction at least 0.80 in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_c_last_extension: Adding last raises retained recovery to at least 80% of the complete pair, with direction fraction at least 0.80 in A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_cue_self_negative_control: Cue+self retains at most 25% of complete-pair mean recovery.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All eight registered arms produce all 64 row outcomes with finite logits and no dropped row.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: license last+period+determiner as the compressed contextual source bank and period+determiner as its two-source core.
terminal.null: The run is valid but B, C, or D fails: preserve only the distributed-source conclusion.
terminal.invalid: Source closure, native capability, alignment, finiteness, or exact coverage fails. No source, head, arm, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First exact multi-source causal compression of the contextual trace read by the localized aspectual heads; the previous test evaluated source terms only one at a time.
